_doc: Spawn director and rank rules (core/monsters). Tiles, seconds, SRD CR. Bands come from world meta.bands; time from the world clock (night: sun below 0.5). budget: total CR (CR 0 counts as 0.125) kept alive around one player group; cr: [min, max] CR of a creature that may spawn there; pack_cr: most CR one pack may add. ranks: what each rank does (hp: as_written | one | max | max2; xp_mult: the XP multiplier the rules track reads from meta xp_mult). rank_roll: weights per band for the leader and standards of a pack; followers of minion-capable kinds become minions with minion_share. Players closer than group_tiles share one budget. view: half the visible rectangle (plus margin) around each player, where nothing spawns.

ramp._doc: Near a surface or sky settlement the band's table is replaced by the near row (day or night), blended back to the band's own between near_tiles and far_tiles from the nearest settlement: budget and pack_cr (CR alive and per pack), max_cr (strongest creature), minion_share (followers that are minions). Closer than ranks_from (0..1 of the way out) packs have no elites or champions. Tuned with tools/arena.gd: a level-1 hero of each class beats one CR 1/4 standard with minions most of the time, not two standards.

promote._doc: the nadir has no SRD wild creature at CR 12-14: half its packs are deeps creatures of CR 5-11 as elites (max HP, an affix, xp x2) and champions (double, two affixes, xp x4)

biome_fallback._doc: Surface biomes worldgen has now, and which ecology biomes they stand in for until worldgen grows more.

lull_s._doc: seconds a player group gets no new pack after one of its director monsters dies, by band[:day|night]

raiders._doc: People packs from data/sim/cultures.json raider recipes, as SRD NPCs with species (make_npc). bandits: surface at night near roads; drow: near deep-road exits (sites with a deep_road route) in the caves and deeps.
